notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
5/28/18
[list]
[*]Added Fallen Drone stats to titlescreen. Now you can see which levels have fallen drones to collect and how many you already found from the level select option.
[*]Fixed some oddities when a player may switch from gamepad use to keyboard and mouse. i.e. Mouse would not capture unless left button click is manually pressed. Mouse would capture and you could not rotate player and shoot. Camera location would remain off centered.
[*]Improved menu navigation so focused selections are highlighted in instead of only being underlined. Adjusted some colors for better contrast.
[/list]
Note I will gather any issues throughout the week and post a patch weekly in addition to prepping the game for the additional expansion.

That's all for now.
